+def _routes(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+    source = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bit.get(source, 0)
+    initial = (source, initial_mask, data["coupons"])
+    start = data["start"]
+    queue = [(start, source, initial_mask, data["coupons"])]
+    best = {initial: start}
+    while queue:
+        arrival, node, mask, remaining = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, remaining)
+        if best.get(state) != arrival:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full:
+            return {"arrival": arrival}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(arrival, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(edge["duration"], remaining)]
+            if remaining:
+                options.append((max(2, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0)), remaining - 1))
+            for duration, left in options:
+                reached = depart + duration
+                if reached > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit.get(next_node, 0)
+                nxt = (next_node, next_mask, left)
+                if reached < best.get(nxt, float("inf")):
